description: Small hand-written runs that pin the rulings settled 10-10 (R7I). input/ is an aborted run that keeps content: its error has message, traceback and traceback_ansi (R7I-7); its model subject model:acme/gpt%20x is exported with the name decoded, acme/gpt x, and comes back as model:acme/gpt%20x (R7I-8, run/); a labelled score is its label and a line with two scores is a map keyed by metric (R7I-2); the two roots of case c1 carry the same times, spelled two ways, and the same duration, which count as one (R7I-5); case c2's input comes from the record its line cites, and an output record no line cites is neither carried nor refused (R7I-6). input-off/ keeps no content: no score gets an explanation (R7I-3, as OT-3). Each run under refusals/ verifies and is refused: two roots with different start times (R7I-5), a cited output record (R7I-6), a reasoning blob that is not UTF-8 (R7I-9).
